entities.text: Pulupichi Srihari vs State Of Ap
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No.4056 of 2019
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed, under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, to quash the proceedings against the petitioners-A.1 and A.2 in C.C. No.470 of 2019 on the file of the Court of the I Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Tenali, for the offences under Sections 420, 272,
273, 188 IPC and Sections 57, 58, 59 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: I Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Tenali
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.
3.
Both the counsels agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.

entities.text: Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
4. In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in C.C. No.470 of 2019 on the file of the Court of the I Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Tenali, for the offences under Sections 420, 272,
273, 188 IPC and Sections 57, 58, 59 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 are hereby quashed.

entities.text: I Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Tenali
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: As a sequel, the Miscellaneous Applications, if any pending shall stand closed.
D.V.S.S. SOMAYAJULU, J Date: 12.7.2019 YS Pulupichi Srihari vs State Of Ap on 12 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76697962/
